question: How many FROM items trigger genetic query optimization by default?
evidence_quote: geqo_threshold ( integer ) Use genetic query optimization to plan queries with at least this many FROM items involved. (Note that a FULL OUTER JOIN construct counts as only one FROM item.) The default is 12.

question: Is genetic query optimization enabled by default?
evidence_quote: geqo ( boolean ) Enables or disables genetic query optimization. This is on by default.

question: Does increasing the planner's disk-cache estimate allocate more shared memory?
expected_answer: No; it is used only for estimation.
evidence_quote: This parameter has no effect on the size of shared memory allocated by PostgreSQL , nor does it reserve kernel disk cache; it is used only for estimation purposes.

question: Does a custom two-part configuration option have any effect before its extension module is loaded?
expected_answer: No; it is treated as a placeholder until the defining module is loaded.
evidence_quote: Such variables are treated as placeholders and have no function until the module that defines them is loaded.

question: What is the default value of default_statistics_target?
evidence_quote: default_statistics_target ( integer ) Sets the default statistics target for table columns without a column-specific target set via ALTER TABLE SET STATISTICS . Larger values increase the time needed to do ANALYZE , but might improve the quality of the planner's estimates. The default is 100.

question: What happens when dynamic_library_path is set to an empty string?
expected_answer: Automatic library path searching is turned off.
evidence_quote: The default value for this parameter is '$libdir' . If the value is set to an empty string, the automatic path search is turned off.

question: What integer range is allowed for geqo_effort?
evidence_quote: geqo_effort ( integer ) Controls the trade-off between planning time and query plan quality in GEQO. This variable must be an integer in the range from 1 to 10.

question: Is plan_cache_mode checked when a plan is prepared or when it is executed?
expected_answer: When the cached plan is executed.
evidence_quote: This setting is considered when a cached plan is to be executed, not when it is prepared.

question: Which setting estimates the cost of fetching a disk page sequentially?
evidence_quote: seq_page_cost ( floating point ) Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of a disk page fetch that is part of a series of sequential fetches.

question: Which setting estimates the cost of fetching a non-sequential disk page?
evidence_quote: random_page_cost ( floating point ) Sets the planner's estimate of the cost of a non-sequentially-fetched disk page.

question: Which setting tells the planner how much disk cache is available to one query?
evidence_quote: effective_cache_size ( integer ) Sets the planner's assumption about the effective size of the disk cache that is available to a single query.

question: Which setting supplies the statistics target for columns without an explicit per-column target?
evidence_quote: default_statistics_target ( integer ) Sets the default statistics target for table columns without a column-specific target set via ALTER TABLE SET STATISTICS .

question: Which parameter offers more granular control than turning geqo off?
evidence_quote: It is usually best not to turn it off in production; the geqo_threshold variable provides more granular control of GEQO.

question: Which pg_config option prints the package library directory used by dynamic_library_path?
evidence_quote: If a list element starts with the special string $libdir , the compiled-in PostgreSQL package library directory is substituted for $libdir ; this is where the modules provided by the standard PostgreSQL distribution are installed. (Use pg_config --pkglibdir to find out the name of this directory.)

question: Which extension name prefixes the custom option plpgsql.variable_conflict?
evidence_quote: Custom options have two-part names: an extension name, then a dot, then the parameter name proper, much like qualified names in SQL. An example is plpgsql.variable_conflict .

question: Which plan_cache_mode value forces a plan that does not depend on parameter values?
evidence_quote: Custom plans are made afresh for each execution using its specific set of parameter values, while generic plans do not rely on the parameter values and can be re-used across executions. Thus, use of a generic plan saves planning time, but if the ideal plan depends strongly on the parameter values then a generic plan may be inefficient. The choice between these options is normally made automatically, but it can be overridden with plan_cache_mode . The allowed values are auto (the default), force_custom_plan and force_generic_plan .

question: What does amtype = i mean in pg_am?
evidence_quote: amtype char t = table (including materialized views), i = index.

question: Which pg_amop column distinguishes search operators from ordering operators?
expected_answer: amoppurpose: s for search, o for ordering.
evidence_quote: amoppurpose char Operator purpose, either s for search or o for ordering

question: What does a rolconnlimit of -1 mean in pg_authid?
expected_answer: No limit on concurrent connections for the role.
evidence_quote: rolconnlimit int4 For roles that can log in, this sets maximum number of concurrent connections this role can make. -1 means no limit.

question: Which evtenabled value makes an event trigger fire in every mode?
evidence_quote: evtenabled char Controls in which modes the event trigger fires. O = trigger fires in origin and local modes, D = trigger is disabled, R = trigger fires in replica mode, A = trigger fires always.

question: Which pg_extension column says whether an extension can move to another schema?
evidence_quote: extrelocatable bool True if extension can be relocated to another schema

question: Which setting controls the join-count threshold for genetic query optimization, and which SQL function can read its current value?

evidence_spans.quote: geqo_threshold ( integer ) Use genetic query optimization to plan queries with at least this many FROM items involved.
The SHOW command allows inspection of the current value of any parameter. The corresponding SQL function is current_setting(setting_name text) (see ).

question: If ALTER ROLE and ALTER DATABASE set conflicting configuration defaults, which takes precedence?
expected_answer: ALTER ROLE's user-specific value overrides the per-database value.
evidence_quote: The ALTER DATABASE command allows global settings to be overridden on a per-database basis. The ALTER ROLE command allows both global and per-database settings to be overridden with user-specific values.

question: What happens to unrecognized custom options when their extension module is loaded?
expected_answer: Warnings are issued and unrecognized placeholders with that extension's prefix are removed.
evidence_quote: When an extension module is loaded, it will add its variable definitions and convert any placeholder values according to those definitions. If there are any unrecognized placeholders that begin with its extension name, warnings are issued and those placeholders are removed.
